lines.text: Many learners say: Welcome to come to my home.
Welcome to! Welcome to my home!

data.wrong: Welcome to come to my home.

native.hook: “欢迎来”不要说 welcome to come！
native.tip: 中文说“欢迎来我家”，“来”也是动词，所以容易说 welcome to come。英语直接说 Welcome to my home。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Welcome to come to my home.”😅 “欢迎来我家”里的“来”不用翻译，直接说 Welcome to：“Welcome to my home.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Welcome to my home.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese, we say "Welcome to my home", and "来" is also a verb, so it is easy to say welcome to come. In English, just say Welcome to my home.
en.caption: Do you say “Welcome to come to my home.” 😅 Welcome to already has the meaning of coming: “Welcome to my home.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
